sections.heading: Pastor Christopher Hall
sections.body: Pr. Hall has served Grace Lutheran since 2012, serving congregations in Enid, OK and Tuscaloosa AL previously. He attended University of Central Oklahoma, receiving a Bachelor degree in Philosophy, summa cum laude, Philosophy student of the year, and Class Marshal/Valedictorian. He attended Concordia Seminary in St. Louis and was an exchange student to Lutherische Theologische Hochschule in Oberursel, Germany in 1997-98. He was ordained on August 13, 2000. Pr. Hall is married to Marjorie and together they have four children. In his free time he enjoys reading, playing cards, board games, and computer games, photography, and supporting the Union High School marching band. He has three dogs, which may be too many.

sections.heading: Marjorie Hall, Parish Musician
sections.body: Marjorie is from Libertyville, IL and grew up in the Chicagoland area. She attended college at Waldorf University, Arizona State, and graduated from Concordia University, Chicago. She taught vocal music education at St. Paul Lutheran School in Mt. Prospect, IL and has served as Director of Music and Parish Musician at St. Paul Lutheran Church, Redeemer Lutheran Church and at Grace Lutheran since 2012. Marjorie has also worked in human resources and with children and youth in her career. She loves her children, her brood of dogs, and supporting her children in the Union Bands program.

sections.heading: DCE Joshua Craig
sections.body:
I was born, baptized, raised, confirmed, and married in the LCMS in the 
Michigan District. I attended an LCMS grade school from preschool 
through eighth grade and the local public high school until I graduated 
in 2010. I graduated from CUAA in May of 2017 with a Bachelor’s in 
Family Life Education and a minor in Youth Ministry. As part of my 
education, I served a practicum with a chaplain at a senior living 
community and a six-month internship as a Director of Family Life 
Ministry. During my schooling, I served as a Director of Youth Ministry 
for several congregations. My first call was as a Director of Christian 
Education at a congregation in Canton, Ohio.

I was married on January 1, 2017 to Madelyn, whom I met on the CUAA 
campus. We had our daughter, Isabella Rose, on March 13, 2019 and our 
son, Matthew James, was born on March 14, 2021. In my free-time I love 
to read and to watch Netflix or Hulu with my family. I am a University 
of Michigan football fan and try to watch every game. I love going on 
walks with my wife and enjoy our long discussions. We both enjoy swing 
dancing together. I’m kind of a nerd, so I play video games, watch 
anime, and I even play D&D. I love to talk things out, because I’m a 
verbal processor and I love to make lists to organize my thoughts. I 
keep a paper schedule book on me at all times. If it’s not in the book, 
I’ll forget it.

Maddy has a four year degree in English and is a self-published author 
of 2 books with more in the works. She is a housewife and a stay-at-home 
mother who loves to sing, play guitar and piano, paint, write, and read. 
She is has a fascination with history and linguistics and apologetics. 
She was homeschooled as a child and having been raised on a farm, she 
loves all animals of various kinds, except spiders and other creepy 
crawlies. She loves to watch historical dramas and read classic 
literature. She also loves sea shanties and bar songs and has learned to 
play/sing several on her guitar.

We plan to homeschool our children as they begin to enter that age. 
Bella is already curious and extroverted. She will literally go up and 
hug just about anyone and is never afraid to say what she is thinking. 
She loves playing at parks and stuffed animals and meeting new friends. 
It feels like she is always on the move and always doing something. I 
have it on good authority that she takes after me. Matthew is a little 
more quiet and introverted, but he is also cuddly and gives great hugs! 
He explores and plays with his sister, but sometimes he'll just sit and 
cuddle with you for long periods of time. He's already folding his hands 
and trying to sing with us during our nightly devotions. Both of our 
kids are great and happy to meet new people!

sections.heading: Makylie Huelsenbeck, Parish Administrator
sections.body:
Makylie Huelsenbeck was confirmed and baptized by Sr. Pr. Hall in 2025. Later that year, she applied for the position of Secretary at Grace Lutheran Church and is excited to serve both the church and its members in this new role.

She brings prior administrative experience and enjoys incorporating creativity into her work. In May 2025, she married Danny Huelsenbeck, and the couple welcomed their son, Jaxson, in December of the same year.

In her free time, Kylie enjoys reading, creating art, and spending time with family and friends. As a new mother, she especially values opportunities for connection and relaxation. She prefers to go by Kylie, as it is easier to remember.
